elements.name: The lamp that lit the village
elements.text:
The lamp that lit the village
blinked out one night

elements.name: A shard of light on the water
elements.text:
A shard of light on the water
was pointing upstream

elements.name: The wind caught the shard
elements.text:
The wind caught the shard
and carried it up the hill

elements.name: ランタンを運ぶアナグマ
Among the sleeping great tree
elements.text:
Among the sleeping great tree
the lantern lay hidden

elements.name: ランタンを運ぶアナグマ
The lantern rose to the sky
elements.text:
The lantern rose to the sky
and the forest was bright again
